name: particle-hero
title: Particle Hero
description: Full-viewport hero with a cursor-reactive WebGL particle field and staggered text reveal.
instruction: A dark full-viewport hero section: a WebGL particle field of thousands of small gray dots that drift gently and, within roughly 120px of the cursor, push away, brighten and enlarge with a smooth falloff — plus a constellation effect: thin foreground-token filaments connect nearby lifted dots to their 2-3 nearest neighbors (alpha tapering with proximity, hard-capped segment count) and a faint soft foreground halo rides the eased cursor, everything spring-easing back to rest and fading out when the cursor leaves. Behind it sits a staggered spring-physics text reveal (mono eyebrow, large tight headline, muted subline) and a single accent CTA, with a radial vignette keeping edges quiet. Strictly monochrome dots/filaments/halo (muted-to-foreground only, no accent). Static dot-grid fallback without WebGL, reduced-motion respected (cursor reaction, filaments and halo disabled).
